# AI Nexus × Neon AI Studio

> AI Nexus × Neon AI Studio (also known as AI Nexus and Neon AI Studio, website neonaistudio.in) is a remote AI ad agency and digital marketing agency. It offers AI video ads and AI video production, video editing and animation, website and app development, logo, branding and graphic design, SEO and digital marketing, social media marketing, AI chatbots and automation, and web hosting with HTTPS security. It serves clients in India, the UAE (Dubai), Kuwait, Luxembourg, Japan, the USA, the UK, Canada, Australia, Germany, Singapore, Ireland, New Zealand, South Africa and worldwide. Orders are taken on WhatsApp at +91 9226520552. Prices are in INR: AI video from 599 per video, hosting from 139 per month, HTTPS set-up 2999.

Key facts:
- Brand: AI Nexus × Neon AI Studio (AI Nexus, Neon AI Studio)
- Website: https://neonaistudio.in/

- Based in Maharashtra, India; all work is delivered remotely worldwide.

## Service categories

- [AI Video Ads & AI Content](https://neonaistudio.in/services.html#ai-video): AI-generated video ads, UGC-style ads, avatar and spokesperson videos, AI reels and AI content for brands and businesses.
- [Video Editing, Production & Animation](https://neonaistudio.in/services.html#video-production): Professional video editing, commercial and promotional video production, product videos, explainers, motion graphics and animation.
- [Web Development & Website Design](https://neonaistudio.in/services.html#web-development): Fast, responsive business websites, ecommerce stores, landing pages, Shopify, WordPress, WooCommerce and custom web development.
- [App Development](https://neonaistudio.in/services.html#app-development): Android, iOS, Flutter and React Native mobile apps, business and ecommerce apps, plus app UI/UX design.
- [Branding, Logo & Graphic Design](https://neonaistudio.in/services.html#branding-design): Logo design, brand identity, graphic design, packaging, posters, flyers, banners, thumbnails, UI/UX and photo editing.
- [SEO & Digital Marketing](https://neonaistudio.in/services.html#seo-digital-marketing): SEO, Google Ads, lead generation, email marketing, content marketing and full-service digital marketing for businesses worldwide.
- [Social Media Marketing & Content](https://neonaistudio.in/services.html#social-media): Instagram, Facebook, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube marketing, ads management, content creation, reels and channel branding.
- [Automation, AI & Software Development](https://neonaistudio.in/services.html#automation-ai-development): AI chatbots, AI automation and integration, workflow and marketing automation, SaaS, full-stack and custom software development.
- [Hosting, Security & IT Solutions](https://neonaistudio.in/services.html#hosting-security): Web hosting plans, HTTPS/SSL security set-up, website maintenance and IT solutions for small businesses.
